summary: Three-tree platform on the Kaniksu National Forest, Boundary County, Idaho: 1930s build, abandoned in the 1940s, still there in the 1980s; no current site record.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in the 1940s. Firelookout.com says the platform was still there in the 1980s. No source says it was removed.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in.

events.note: Three-tree platform; sources give only the 1930s
Platform still there in the 1980s, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: 1930s three-tree platform, still there in the 1980s, abandoned in the 1940s
location 14 miles southeast of Bonners Ferry, Boundary County
listed as Timber Ridge (Mountain) in Kaniksu National Forest
listed as platform with status abandoned

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association list shows this site as Platform, status Abandoned. No source says the platform was removed or destroyed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Weebly page is titled Timber Ridge, but its body says TIMBER MOUNTAIN. The county list gives TIMBER RIDGE (MOUNTAIN) at the same 60N-3E-20 location. The record keeps Timber Ridge and treats Timber Mountain as an other name.
Idaho Fire Lookouts dates abandonment to the 1940s. Firelookout.com says the platform was still there in the 1980s. Both can be true; no source says when the platform came down.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: sources give decade-only dates and no current site description. Staffing is left out because Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented. The brief's status 'gone' is not supported by any source; the proposed correction is 'abandoned'. No photos added: firelookout.com has a 'Click for larger image' link but no image URL was extracted. Story is short on purpose.
